profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at EKO Strategies, LLC
profile.summary:
My name is Raymond Kim. Coding Dojo Graduate. Full Stack Developer at EKO Strategies LLC

Proficient in JavaScript, but can work with Java and Python. With an interest towards front end frameworks. Love working with clean sites that are easy to navigate and pretty to look at. 

I previously was a pastor and an assistant at an oral surgery office. Was looking for a change in career and found myself applying to the Coding Dojo boot camp to gain skills in the technology field. Fell in love with software development, creating projects, and problem solving. 

Always looking to connect and learn more!

Email me: ray.kim09@gmail.com

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
EKO Strategies, LLC is certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that specializes in Strategic Information Technology and Management Consulting for our commercial and government clients. 

When it comes to technology, one thing for certain is that nothing is going to stay the same. As the ever-changing world of technology is the driving force behind just about everything in today's world regardless of industry, it is essential to us, and our customer's success.

We aim to provide our commitment to excellence by incorporation of industry's best practice into your business process and management strategies. By working hand-in-hand to solve the most complex challenges, and providing the latest and cutting-edge technological solutions, we make Your Mission, Our Mission.

As a Full Stack Developer:
- Using Angular 9, NodeJS, TypeORM, MariaDB, I created/enhanced an application to serve the needs of the client to take large datasets and compare to find differences in monthly changes to Microsoft Project files. 
- Also used advanced Angular techniques to create Angular elements, web components, to create complex components within an already established non Angular application.
- Helped create and design visual dashboards for end users.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
IncrediTek is one of the nation’s premier Added-Value Reseller and Service and Support companies that gives your carrier-class network a reliable partner. As a solutions or service provider, the success of your business is dependent upon the enabling network infrastructure and supporting processes. Planning, implementing and maintaining a network that is cost-effective, robust and flexible enough to meet future needs is critical for achieving an optimal Return on Investment (ROI).

As a developer:
- Currently updating and modernizing internal legacy application.

positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description:
Vintun provides actionable insights to our clients through data analytics enabling them to effectively execute their mission and vision.

-Created/Maintained product for PEO Soldier PM SSL using Edge Technologies infrastructure on top of ServiceNow with extensive knowledge of HTML, CSS, & JavaScript to create customized dashboard for client
-Pioneered data integrity by designing and creating a comparison tool that shows the client what monthly changes were being made from a baseline schedule to help shift focus on areas of need more quickly, tool helped cut down monthly deep dive meetings from 6+ hours to 2 hours
-Train/Meet with 3 team staff weekly, which includes teaching software development, HTML, CSS, JavaScript understanding and best practices
- Attended and presented in booth at AFCEA WEST 2019 in San Diego, CA - demoed dashboard and customization capabilities built for the PEO Soldier project to bring in potential new clients

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
REI specializes in application modernization using cloud- and platform-based solutions, grants management, and data analytics and visualization. Ranked #2 among large IT employers in top workplaces from the Washington Post in 2018. 

As an associate developer:
- Collaborated on modernization of the NASA SBIR/STTR Electronic Handbook.
- Worked with Angular 5+, HTML, & CSS to help create functional products for the proposal submission process.
- Created and helped implement highlighting and commenting within the nomination process for the Electronic Handbook using Angular 5+ and plain JavaScript functions.

positions.title: Resident
positions.description:
Spent over 1000 hours in an immersive 14 week program on multiple assignments and projects with the ability to create web applications from scratch starting from the back-end to the front-end. Graduated with a triple black belt in Python, MEAN, and Java. 

Full Stack developer in: 
- Python: Django with understanding of Flask and MySQL
- MEAN: MongoDB, Mongoose, Express.js, Angular2, and Node.js
- Java: Spring Boot, Spring Security

Also proficient in HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Javascript, and jQuery

positions.title: Lead Surgical Assistant
positions.description:
Top Oral Surgeons in the Northern Virginia Area. Worked with highly accomplished oral surgeons on a daily basis to streamline wonderful patient care. Strived daily to provide the best service and treatment while building up relationships with a large network of dentists in the area.

Responsibilities:
- Managed and led a team of wonderful assistants
- Organized daily task and responsibilities
- Worked alongside the doctors to help streamline treatment planning

Also created and designed employee handbook for training and created summary sheets for Doctor's calls with referring dentists.

positions.title: Youth Pastor
positions.description:
Youth Pastor for approximately 30 students in the Fairfax Station area.  Students ranged from 6th grade to 12th grade and I worked with them weekly creating opportunities to build up relationships and spend time learning theology. 

Responsibilities:
- Weekly Sermons
- Weekly study sessions at local libraries to meet and help students with their school work
- Set up and planned annual 4 day retreats
